nodes.label: BiDi Tab Model
nodes.rationale: Camoufox runs headless with no visible tab strip, so tabs are just top-level BiDi browsing contexts opened, attached to, and closed via helpers (list_tabs, new_tab, switch_tab, current_tab, close_tab, page_info, iframe_target).

nodes.label: BiDi Context Id (target_id)
nodes.rationale: target_id in every helper is the BiDi context id, a stable UUID for the tab, the analog of the old CDP target id.

nodes.label: Snapshot Invalidation on Navigation
nodes.rationale: Navigating away invalidates a snapshot's refs; take a fresh browser snapshot after navigation, and re-read element rects after opening dropdowns/modals before coordinate-clicking.
